attempts.sql: WITH apimodel AS (SELECT s.symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols AS s WHERE s.name = 'ApiModel' AND s.file_id = 'auto_ontology/server/models.py'), direct AS (SELECT b.class_symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS b JOIN apimodel AS am ON b.base_symbol_id = am.symbol_id UNION SELECT b.class_symbol_id FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_bases AS b WHERE regexp_extract(regexp_replace(b.base_name, '[[].*[]]', '', 'g'), '([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)$', 1) IN ('ApiModel', '_Payload')) SELECT a.class_symbol_id AS class_symbol_id, MIN(a.depth) AS depth FROM auto_ontology_code.code.class_ancestry AS a JOIN apimodel AS am ON a.ancestor_symbol_id = am.symbol_id WHERE a.depth >= 2 AND a.class_symbol_id NOT IN (SELECT d.class_symbol_id FROM direct AS d) GROUP BY a.class_symbol_id ORDER BY a.class_symbol_id

request:
Which classes inherit from ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/models.py) only indirectly, i.e. through at least one intermediate class of this repository, and do not name ApiModel directly in their class statement? An import alias of ApiModel (auto_ontology/server/responses.py imports it as _Payload) counts as naming ApiModel directly, and a subscripted base such as ListResponse[T] counts as its class. For each, give the class symbol ID and the length of the shortest inheritance chain to ApiModel (2 when the parent class directly subclasses ApiModel).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), depth (integer).
Return exactly the requested output columns, using each requested name as the column alias, in the requested order. Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.
explanation: This lists every class that reaches ApiModel only through one or more intermediate classes, together with the shortest inheritance distance to it. Ancestry rows are matched to the ApiModel symbol defined in the server models file, classes that mention ApiModel (or its _Payload import alias) directly as a base are excluded, and the minimum recorded depth per class is returned for distances of two or more.
